title: Zexie Tang targeting FKBP38/mTOR/SREBPs pathway improves hyperlipidemia.
authors: Xie, Zhishen; Li, Er-Wen; Gao, Gai; Du, Yueyue; Wang, Mengyao; Wang, Hui; Wang, Pan; Qiao, Yonghui; Su, Yunfang; Xu, Jiangyan; Zhang, Xiaowei; Zhang, Zhenqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药泽泻汤通过FKBP38/mTOR/SREBPs通路改善高脂血症，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Zexie Tang (ZXT), only two consists with Alismatis Rhizoma (AR) and Atractylodes macrocephala Rhizoma (AM), a classical Chinese medicine formula from Synopsis of the Golden Chamber with a history of 2000 years. Clinical observation in recent years has found that ZXT has excellent lipid-lowering effect. AIM OF THE STUDY: To explore the potential mechanism of ZXT ameliorates hyperlipidemia based on FKBP38/mTOR/SREBPs pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: WD-induced hyperlipidemia mice and oleic acid induced cell lipid accumulation model were used to investigate pharmacodynamic. The effect of ZXT on the transcriptional activity of SREBPs was detected by reporter gene assay. Proteins and downstream genes of mTOR/SREBPs pathway were detected in vivo and in vitro. Combined with network pharmacology and HPLC-Q-TOF/MS, the active ingredients were screened and identified. The interaction between active compounds of ZXT and FKBP38 protein were analyzed by docking analysis. RESULTS: ZXT decreased TC, TG and LDL-c levels in blood of WD-induced hyperlipidemia mouse model, and improved insulin resistance in vivo. ZXT also reduced TC, TG and lipid accumulation in cells line, and inhibited SREBPs luciferase activity, protein and its target genes expression such as FASN, HMGCR, etc. Meanwhile, ZXT inhibited protein expression levels of p-mTOR, p-S6K, etc in vitro and in vivo. Combined with network pharmacology and HPLC-Q-TOF/MS, 16 active ingredients were screened and identified. Docking results showed that active compounds of ZXT binding to FKBP38 and formed hydrogen bond. CONCLUSION: Our findings highlighted that ZXT ameliorates hyperlipidemia, in which FKBP/mTOR/SREBPs pathway might be the potential regulatory mechanism.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：泽泻汤（ZXT），仅由泽泻（Alismatis Rhizoma, AR）和白术（Atractylodes macrocephala Rhizoma, AM）两味药组成，是源自《金匮要略》的经典中药方剂，拥有2000年的历史。近年来的临床观察发现，ZXT具有优异的降脂效果。研究目的：基于FKBP38/mTOR/SREBPs通路，探讨ZXT改善高脂血症的潜在机制。材料与方法：采用西式饮食（WD）诱导的高脂血症小鼠和油酸诱导的细胞脂质积累模型来评估药效。通过报告基因实验检测ZXT对SREBPs转录活性的影响。在体内和体外实验中检测mTOR/SREBPs通路相关蛋白及下游基因的表达。结合网络药理学和高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱（HPLC-Q-TOF/MS），筛选并鉴定活性成分。通过分子对接分析ZXT活性化合物与FKBP38蛋白之间的相互作用。结果：ZXT降低了WD诱导的高脂血症小鼠血液中的总胆固醇（TC）、甘油三酯（TG）和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-c）水平，并在体内改善了胰岛素抵抗。ZXT还降低了细胞系中的TC、TG和脂质积累，并抑制了SREBPs荧光素酶活性、蛋白及其靶基因（如FASN、HMGCR等）的表达。同时，ZXT在体外和体内均抑制了p-mTOR、p-S6K等蛋白的表达水平。结合网络药理学和HPLC-Q-TOF/MS，筛选并鉴定了16种活性成分。对接结果显示，ZXT的活性化合物与FKBP38结合并形成氢键。结论：我们的研究结果强调，ZXT改善高脂血症，其中FKBP/mTOR/SREBPs通路可能是其潜在调控机制。
